passives.name: Reactive Armor
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Attack every turn. This effect stacks up to 20 times. If the caster is not inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4076006_11_3]. Additionally, when an enemy makes a non-critical hit, increases Priority of all allies by [Buff_V_4076006_11_4], and reduces the cooldown of Guardian Cannon by [Buff_V_4076006_11_2] turn(s). Increases damage dealt to non-Water enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them.
